task.title: Finally verify operations sources and notification consumption after restart
task.input: stats-reliability/ops-sources, real cron and the dedicated chat SMTP adapter
task.output: operations-acceptance: source-failure and actual notification-scheduling evidence
task.accept: 1) An isolated SMTP receiver accepts actual chat notifications. Verify attempt/sent/failed/unknown outcomes and explicit HTTP-count coverage. Stop one auxiliary source: stats keeps original success times/stale values or not_connected, while core remains readable. An unverified backup is never labeled recoverable (E-64, E-65, E-67). 2) Direct requests to protected notification-related entries from unauthenticated/EDITOR sessions are refused; cron accepts only Bearer. chat-notifications uses a dedicated limited adapter without extending the old mail UI. Verify an actual every-minute cron registration, save a message, restart and wait for scheduled persistent-outbox consumption. A manual HTTP call or empty registration is insufficient; notification failure cannot roll back received (E-94).
